name: pod-oom-killed
description: Container killed by kernel OOM (lastState.terminated.reason=OOMKilled, exitCode=137). Investigate memory footprint and recent traffic.

name: pod-crashloopbackoff
description: Container repeatedly failing to start (Event reason=BackOff, state.waiting.reason=CrashLoopBackOff). Investigate exit code, startup logs, recent changes.

name: alert-db-pool-waiting
description: DB connection pool waiting clients > 0 (pg_pool_waiting_clients). Investigate slow queries, traffic spike, pool size.

name: alert-high-cpu
description: Pod CPU usage exceeded threshold. Investigate traffic correlation, CPU-bound processing, single-pod abnormality.

name: alert-high-error-rate
description: HTTP 5xx rate above threshold. Investigate per-route distribution, error logs, dependency failures, recent deploys.
